I am renting this small plot here in Kilimanjaro, so I must be careful with money. The rains usually come well enough on the slopes, so I do not need to irrigate — I will rely on the season's rain like my neighbors. I can afford a small bag of fertilizer and some improved maize seed from the agrodealer in town, and I will add manure from my goats to stretch the soil. My two older children help me in the field, but for weeding and harvest I will call one or two people from the village for a few days.
